summary: Frontend-only tests for the new Sample Professional Report page. All required test-ids, sections, content assertions, PDF endpoint, and navigation flows pass. One real UI bug found: horizontal overflow on mobile 390px caused by the header's 'Download Sample PDF' button (whitespace-nowrap) combined with the back link + logo in a justify-between row.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width. scrollWidth=485, clientWidth=390. The header row (Sample Reports back link + BrandLogo + Download Sample PDF button) does not wrap because the Button contains 'Download Sample PDF' with whitespace-nowrap. Overflowing element identified: a[data-testid=sample-pro-pdf-btn] with right=485.

issues: Header row overflows viewport horizontally by ~95px due to non-wrapping PDF download button label.

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow on /samples/professional-report: shorten the header PDF button label on small screens (e.g., hide the text and keep only the download icon on <sm, or use text 'PDF' on mobile), OR allow header items to wrap (flex-wrap) so no element overflows the 390px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: SampleProfessionalReport.jsx uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL directly for the PDF href which is correct, but the same URL is duplicated in Samples.jsx — consider a small shared helper.
Console shows 401 errors from /api/auth/me on public pages (expected for unauthenticated user); AuthContext could suppress that noise on public routes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: /samples renders sample-card-professional-report above samples-grid (7 grid cards preserved); View link navigates to /samples/professional-report; sample-pro-title == 'Sample Professional Report'; s1..s9 all visible; sample-pro-level = 'Level 6/10 — Level 4-6: Moderate Conflict / Low Trust'; sample-pro-history contains both v1 score 4 with 'superseded' and v2 score 6 with 'From Level 4:' note; s4 lists alignment/differences/child-focused; s6 has agree / do not agree / partial / summary fields; s7 shows Options & resources, 'Northside ISD Reading Intervention Program', and 'Conflict-management techniques'; sample-pro-pdf-btn href = https://align-report.preview.emergentagent.com/api/joint/sample-professional-report/pdf and GET returns 200 application/pdf; sample-pro-register-btn navigates to /auth?mode=register; regression /samples/education and landing / load fine, no 'Options and Resources' on education. Outstanding issue: mobile overflow on /samples/professional-report at 390px (only the PDF button in header).
rca of the issue: Header uses flex row with items-center justify-between gap-3 wrapping three items: back link, BrandLogo, and a shadcn Button containing 'Download Sample PDF' text with whitespace-nowrap. At 390px, the combined intrinsic widths exceed viewport so the outermost container's overflow leaks. Fixes: (a) responsive label — show icon only on <sm and full text on sm+; (b) apply flex-wrap or truncate the label; (c) reduce button padding on mobile.
